verdict.rationale: First-party SvelteKit docs say pages in src/routes are server-rendered so a user's first visit is as fast as possible, and that rendering modes can be mixed per page. Community reports corroborate clear server-vs-client loading and easy rendering of components to HTML strings. Nothing in the pack documents streaming responses, so only the SSR half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of streaming SSR (e.g. streamed promises or chunked HTML), and evidence of hydration or time-to-interactive behavior.
